messages:
maria-g: Heads-up — we're seeing a 5xx spike hitting hosted inference endpoints after the rollout this morning. Error rate ~12% 503s, customers hitting /v1/generate. CS ticket CS-4821 incoming.
samir: @maria-g thanks. Is this global or region-specific?
maria-g: Appears to be mostly us-west and eu-west. latency also up on some routes.
ops-bot: [alert] 503 rate > 10% on service/inference-proxy in us-west for 10m
jess-pratt: Any recent config changes? flags, routing, kernel updates?
maria-g: We rolled the new routing overlay and sticky session routing to reduce tail latency. Flag: route.sticky_session=true
support-tom: Customer repro steps in CS-4821: POST /v1/generate with large context (~8k tokens) -> request hangs then 503. Correlation id 0a7f... shown in logs.
oncall-ryan: I'm pulling tracer logs for correlation id 0a7f...
samir: I see a pattern: requests routed to variant `gptx-9b-quant` on dedicated pool but kernel fallback isn't in place for long context -> OOM/timeouts causing 503
jess-pratt: That variant was part of canary set at 10% traffic. Did rollout accidentally push higher weight?
maria-g: Hmm, checking rollout weights... looks like overlay rules were mis-evaluated for customers with sticky cookie, sending all returning sessions to canary.
maria-g: Repro locally: curl -H 'Cookie: session=abc' -d '{"input":"...8k tokens..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -> 503
samir: Stack trace from worker log: "KV cache allocation failed: insufficient memory" then proxy returns 503
jess-pratt: OK rollback policy: revert route.sticky_session and reduce canary weight to 0. I'll start rollback now.
deploy-bot: Rollout change requested by jess-pratt: set route.sticky_session=false
maria-g: Pushing temporary patch to routing overlay to re-evaluate weights.
oncall-ryan: I can flip traffic slice to stable pool for affected customer IDs. Need confirm on time.
support-tom: Please also capture logs for CS-4821 and add to ticket. Customer is on a paid enterprise plan, asking for ETA.
samir: Quick mitigation: add kernel fallback mapping so quant variant falls back to fp16 variant when context > 4k. I'll open PR.
jess-pratt: Rollback applied. ops-bot: [info] rollout rollback complete — route.sticky_session=false
ops-bot: [info] canary weight set to 0% for gptx-9b-quant
maria-g: Errors dropping. 503s down from 12% -> 1.2% in 6m. Latency normalizing.
support-tom: Noted — updated CS-4821 with mitigation steps and ETA for permanent fix (kernel fallback PR).
oncall-ryan: Next steps: add automated check to ensure sticky routing respects canary caps and add alerting rule on per-variant OOMs.
samir: I'll add unit test for overlay evaluation and add fallback mapping in runtime.
jess-pratt: Thanks team. After PR merges we'll schedule a controlled canary with synthetic load to validate.
maria-g: Filing postmortem and timeline. Tagging ops and eng-run.
support-tom: Customer notified. closing loop when permanent fix deployed. :thumbsup:
